name: 63304 · Saint Charles, MO
findings: ZIP 63304 (Saint Charles) has 113 nonprofit organizations. 59 of them (52%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 43 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (35% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 63304 (Saint Charles) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 63304 (Saint Charles) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 56% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 34 organizations here; 42% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find ways to volunteer now, including outside formal organizations?
